description.value: Kaslo & District Public Library is a public library serving the village of Kaslo and surrounding area on Kootenay Lake, offering physical collections, digital lending, computer access, and outreach programs. It functions as a community hub with accessible services and multilingual digital resources. For a touring cyclist passing through this small historic village, it represents one of the few spots offering free public services in town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the library is active (copyright 2026, upcoming events listed) and corroborates OSM contact details — phone 1.250.353.2942 and address 413 Fourth Street, Kaslo, BC V0G 1M0 match OSM. OSM carries internet_access=wlan but the website only mentions 'Computers & Printing' and a 'Computer & Internet Use' policy without explicitly stating Wi-Fi availability, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water, or any other cyclist-specific amenity, so all required criteria and most optional amenities are null.
concerns: OSM addr:street uses '4th Street' while website consistently uses 'Fourth Street' — minor discrepancy, same location.
OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed as public Wi-Fi from website text alone; website only references computer workstations and a Computer & Internet Use policy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate, active public facility in a small touring community, but none of the required cyclist criteria (bike parking, water, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to determine whether it qualifies for listing.

blurb: Kaslo's public library, near the Kootenay Lake waterfront.
